name: mandate-supervisor-copilot-runtime
description: Dependency manifest for the CopilotKit runtime container. Deliberately separate from dashboard/package.json: the runtime imports four packages, while the dashboard's production tree also carries every frontend library @copilotkit/react-core pulls in (mermaid, streamdown, lucide-react, date-fns), which the server never loads. Installing the dashboard tree here cost 811 MB of node_modules for a translator that needs none of it. Versions are pinned to exactly what dashboard/package.json resolves, so dev (npm --prefix dashboard run copilot-runtime) and the container run identical code.
